steps.note: an eight second recording cut in three, playhead in the middle piece: the strip lights that block in the accent and the trash button is beside the cut

the trim handles open and the middle piece is STILL the picked one: it wears a white hairline and a slightly stronger fill, quiet enough that the accent handles and the accent window border still read as the window
the start handle has come in to the first join, so the first piece is on its way out; the middle piece is still the picked one and the trash is still on the row

Delete took the picked piece while the handles were open, and the window came with it: the start handle is where it was left and the end handle has slid back by the length that went, instead of both jumping to the ends
one undo puts the piece back and puts the window back with it, still in trim mode, still on the same pick
Done keeps what the handles were showing and lands the playhead at the start, so the first of what is left is the picked one: the strip says so in the accent again
